notes.title: Update 11/03/2022 - Version 1.0.1.2 (9863688)
notes.notes:
Hey guys!
I just released a new update for TOGUM,
The game is now much more optimized, smaller, with new content and bug fixes :)

NOVIDADES:

1 - More optimized and smaller game:
I managed to reduce more 800 MB of the game, keeping it in the total size of 4.3 GB.
The game has also been optimized to improve the number of frames per second and reduce camera glitches. You will notice that the game is much lighter to play, especially on the map outside Priscilla's house.

However, this update will uninstall and reinstall your game, I apologize for the inconvenience but it was the only way I managed to make the optimization happen, so its size is 4.3 gb.


2 - Added the Codex:
The CODEX was added to the main menu, there you can see the main characters and a little more about Priscilla and Erika's history.

I also added Sayonara's father: Ramon Martinez, he was also added to the game and is a character you can talk to :)


3 - Save/Load:
Now if you're in the neighborhood, you can save anywhere you want and not just at Priscilla's house.
Also added an option to load your last Save in the Menu.


4 - There are now "notes" scattered around town with tips and a bit of game's lore

5 - Added a new outfit for Priscilla the "Fighter Outfit". The outfit is the same one worn by Danielle in the first version of the game. And if you want, you can also keep using the school uniform.


Bugs fixes:

1 - Fixed a bug that caused Priscilla to appear at the ending with her school outfit even though you had chosen another outfit for her.

2 - Fixed a bug that caused the game to crash at random times if you talked to Sayonara and entered Priscilla's house later.

3 - Fixed the bug that caused the ambient sound to sometimes not play.

4 - Fixed a bug that if you tried to activate the pad while running, the "Back" button would get stuck on the screen.


 Known bugs:

1 - There is a small bug in Priscilla's left eye in the skin (Fighter). It will be fixed in a future update.
